scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the next seven NVIDIA originals. No workflow was executed and no source was permanently excluded.
linked_reference_caveat: Only these seven complete originals were read. Companion contracts, datasets, model weights, platform scripts, installed SDKs and full licenses need separate review. Examples and source assertions do not establish this host's capabilities or new experimental outcomes.

sources.workflow: Curate approved synthetic clinical terms and categories, generate sentence variants, apply verified pronunciation overrides followed by dictionary lookup or model fallback, synthesize QA audio, satisfy the documented audition gate, and generate actual audio for the approved Cartesian product plus the extended NeMo manifest. Scoring belongs to the next stage rather than this build stage.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Completed setup, working synthesis runtime, authorized hosted TTS credentials or separately prepared self-hosted model service, approved synthetic terms, selected voices and a writable cycle directory are required. Dictionary access is optional and its omission has a declared fallback. Template sentences may replace unavailable Data Designer generation, but neither fallback replaces speech synthesis. Pronunciation and manifest references determine exact phoneme, override and audio requirements. Real patient material is not a suitable study input.
sources.offline_assessment: The default isolated Python container cannot call hosted speech or dictionary services and has no self-hosted speech model. Mechanical sentence templates or a valid JSONL manifest alone do not complete this source's audio-generation goal. A separately selected manifest-validation subtask using existing unchanged public synthetic audio could be offline work, but needs the exact schema and source provenance. No speech request, patient data access, audition claim or API retry occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile the approved term list, fixed categories, sentence variants, voice and noise combinations, IPA provenance and append-only overrides with every actual audio file and manifest row. Verify real sample encoding, duration, path existence, missing-row handling and the recorded audition decision. Phoneme-inventory acceptance does not prove intended pronunciation, and this build stage cannot claim a measured recognition metric or statistically meaningful improvement.

sources.workflow: Extend an actual existing DPDK application with DOCA interoperability rather than replacing its dataplane. Use the installed bridge surface to hand over DPDK ports, convert buffers, query capability and debug bridge-specific errors. This original is a thin loader: detailed supported operations and executable steps are owned by separate capability and task documents.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A compatible Linux host with actual DOCA and DPDK installations in the required matched version window, supported BlueField or ConnectX hardware, existing DPDK source code and appropriate device and hugepage privileges are assumed. Installed package metadata and headers determine real APIs. The capability, task, version, structured-tool and sample-modification contracts require separate review. The skill deliberately does not ship a ready standalone application or build manifest.
sources.offline_assessment: The default non-root Python-only runtime has neither SDK nor native toolchain, hardware device access or the required existing packet-processing application. Invented bridge APIs, a PLACEHOLDER program or a fake installed package would not complete this workflow. A separately selected code-only change against an actual public application and reviewed SDK could be bounded work, but would not establish working packet I/O or hardware offload. No devices, interfaces, permissions or shared services were changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact installed version coupling, original application and sample provenance, actual compiler and linker evidence, port-to-device identity, buffer lifecycle and selected capability/error semantics. Runtime claims need the corresponding real isolated device observations and packet correctness oracle, not simply source generation or a zero build exit. Preserve the distinction between the bridge and native DOCA I/O or standalone flow programming.

sources.workflow: Implement an Earth2Studio prognostic wrapper from an actual reference inference script, including the required inheritance, coordinate and time-step behavior, model loading, forward pass, iterator, optional dependency extra, documentation and tests. Mock tests and a real-weight package test have separate explicit roles. Registration and extended comparison or pull-request work are conditional.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual Earth2Studio checkout, reference inference script, compatible Python environment and base scientific libraries are required. Model-specific dependencies and real weights depend on the selected reference, and need identity and license review. The skeleton, method, testing and validation references define details. The source requires package integration and real-weight testing rather than treating a mock as its entire model. It does not impose a universal GPU requirement for every possible wrapper.
sources.offline_assessment: Code generation and mock interface testing could be offline when the unchanged public reference and actual checkout, dependencies and templates are available. The standard-library container does not provide that scientific runtime or real weights by assumption. A passing dummy model test is not a real checkpoint forward pass or a weather-accuracy result. A synthetic identity example is source guidance, not a substitute for the selected public inference implementation or a newly observed study outcome.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Derive expected coordinate labels, north-to-south latitude, shapes, lead-time increments, hooks and initial-condition iterator behavior from the actual reference and framework contract. Check generated source, dependency extras, docs and invalid-coordinate behavior in the real framework. Retain separate mock and actual checkpoint test results and any model-specific tolerances. Do not expose private grader targets or equate wrapper integration with forecast quality.

sources.workflow: Resolve the actual healthcare workflow checkout, inspect current architecture and live supported workflows and modes, then provide a concise architecture summary and route the requested work to one narrow stage skill. This source is an orientation router, not an instruction to run simulation or training during every invocation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A readable actual base checkout or authorized access to obtain one, its current architecture and ownership documents, and a working support-discovery entrypoint are required. If discovery fails because setup is incomplete, that limitation must be reported rather than silently using the static table. Simulation, dataset, policy and GPU prerequisites belong to whichever separately selected stage is actually requested.
sources.offline_assessment: Orientation can be a faithful offline task with a pinned real public checkout and reviewed discovery script, without running a simulator or training model. Those concrete assets and the discovery script are not supplied by reading this original. The default container's Python support does not by itself establish the shell entrypoint or repository runtime. No checkout was cloned and no stop command or workflow stage was executed for this review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the response's exact workflow and mode list against captured actual discovery output and the pinned architecture and ownership documents. Check the recommended stage against the requested goal and ensure unsupported modes remain unsupported. Do not credit simulation, HDF5 conversion, annotation, training or rollout completion for an orientation answer.

sources.workflow: Run the actual integrated Nova Carter simulated warehouse showcase using the packaged runner, local GUI Isaac Sim, resolved upstream adapters and Mission Control stack. Establish measured readiness, execute the declared route when demo mode is selected, retain motion and mission evidence, and stop only resources owned by the run when requested.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A compatible existing local Isaac Sim installation and display, supported GPU and driver, sufficient host memory and swap, exact robot and warehouse assets, Docker for the cloud stack and robot simulation components, free required ports, compatible ROS bridge and verified upstream dependency manifest are required. The source forbids substituting containerized Isaac Sim or a browser viewer. Actual adapter contracts, version lock, runner and readiness probes require review. Existing installations and unrelated processes must remain intact.
sources.offline_assessment: The default isolated standard-library container cannot supply a host GUI simulator, ROS graph, GPU, Docker stack or robot assets. Locally cached assets alone do not create the required integrated runtime. Dry-run command rendering or a fabricated mission-result file is not motion or successful simulation. No simulator, container stack, mission, installation or shared process was started, stopped or changed during review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Bind the exact run manifest, stage and map hashes, robot identity and actual submitted mission to measured sensor timestamps, transforms, readiness, native process health and zero OOM events. A demo needs the actual mission database terminal completion, same robot returning healthy and idle, and retained pose evidence of motion. A visible GUI, screenshot, log line or idle sample cannot replace those observations.

sources.workflow: Read the actual Jetson target's device-tree model, release header, optional power-mode query, kernel, uptime and operating-system version and print the concise baseline report. Detect a non-Jetson target and exit early instead of printing misleading device information.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Execution must occur on a real running Jetson target rather than the host PC. Readable target system files and the documented standard shell utilities are needed. The power-mode utility is optional and missing data must remain explicitly unavailable. No data input, model, credentials or installation is inherently required for the local target inspection.
sources.offline_assessment: Actual target inspection can be offline on a suitable Jetson, but the default container does not become a Jetson because example system strings are copied into it. A negative non-Jetson observation could be retained only under a separately frozen rejection task and exact environment contract, not counted as successful target inventory. No device file, power setting or target was accessed or changed for this original-body review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare each reported field with independently captured contemporaneous target values, distinguishing absent commands and files from actual measurements. Verify the non-Jetson exit gate and honest unavailable power-mode reporting, including real shell-pipeline exit behavior rather than assuming a fallback executes. The report does not measure clocks, thermals, rail power or performance.

sources.workflow: Validate an actual NeMo reinforcement-learning recipe and its separate infrastructure profile, select the requested ephemeral or long-lived Ray lifecycle, submit real training work, monitor native jobs and logs, and verify run state and teardown appropriate to the selected mode. Debugging and development-pod operations are conditional, not universal completion steps.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual compatible command-line implementation, recipe, inherited configs and infrastructure examples, an authorized Kubernetes and KubeRay environment, appropriate GPU topology and scheduler support, model and training data, storage, images and required namespace grants are needed. Secret references must already exist when the selected profile needs them. Submission code source and entrypoint determine which actual recipe is tested. The separate CLI implementation and schemas require review.
sources.offline_assessment: The default offline standard-library container has no cluster, native submitter, GPU workers or training runtime and must not reach a live shared cluster for study tests. Manifest validation or dry-run rendering may be separately selected offline subtasks after the actual source and inputs are reviewed, but do not launch or complete training. Stubbed job states, prompt-progress lines or edited YAML cannot count as native cluster execution.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Bind the actual recipe and infra hashes, effective code and overrides, native submission or driver identity, selected lifecycle, real worker and job states, logs and resulting training artifacts. Distinguish an accepted or running launch from completed training, and complete ephemeral teardown from a merely retained job object. Preserve native failure and usage evidence. Never infer a learned-model or benchmark improvement from the source's minimal launch checklist.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
